content_name: QA What Is the Most Scratch Resistant Flooring

actions.caption:
Most scratch-resistant flooring? Two winners: high-grade laminate rated AC4/AC5, and rigid vinyl plank with a 20 mil+ wear layer.

Those ratings aren't marketing. They're the two numbers to ask for when you shop: AC grade on laminate, wear layer thickness on vinyl. Everything else is sales talk.

We key-tested all three on camera so you don't have to. Cheap floors save you money once. Scratch-rated floors save you regret for fifteen years.

Want to try it yourself? Come scratch our floors. Mississauga showroom, address in bio 📍
